https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Ask up 22% in a week to ¥36,000, 20% above where sales clear
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask climbed from ¥29,400 to ¥36,000 in a week while my tier index slipped about 2.5%. Recent sales median is ¥30,000, though the latest prints reached ¥35,000, and sales pace rose to about 2.5 a day from 1.4. Only 12 of 20 listings sit within 15% of the ask.

Why: The cheap copies are being bought and sellers relist higher; the rising sales pace and last prints near ¥34,700-35,000 show some real buying, but this is my reading of the data, not a confirmed cause. I did not research external news this run.

For you: ¥36,000 is above the Buy line (¥29,500) and the ¥35,500 ceiling, far above your ¥26,000 limit. It stays a Watch.

Watch: whether sales keep printing at ¥34,000+ or fall back toward ¥30,000.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.headline: Ask jumped 7% while the rest of the market fell, on thinner trading
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.text: The lowest ask rose from ¥41,000 to ¥43,900 over a week in which my tier index fell 8%. Sales slowed sharply, from about 7.5 a day to 2.5, so the rise looks like sellers pulling cheaper listings rather than new demand. That is a guess from the data, not a confirmed cause. The ask sits above the Buy line (¥38,000) and your limit (¥35,000), so there is nothing to do; watch whether sales pick back up before treating this as a new floor.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.headline: Lowest ask 11% under recent sales, but price is still sliding
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask is ¥100,000, about 11% under the ¥112,000 median of recent sales. The sales print sequence has stepped down from ¥120,000–125,000 on 09-25 to ¥97,900–105,000 over the last few days, and trading is about 2.9 sales a day.

Why: Likely the same market-wide correction seen in the tier index, and sellers marking down to keep selling. That is a reading of the data, not a confirmed cause; I found no reprint or supply news for this set.

For you: The ask is now under the Buy line (¥108,000) and just above Definitely-buy (¥98,000), but still well above your ¥70,000 limit. The correction rule allows Buy only at or below Definitely-buy, so this stays Watch.

Watch: Whether another step down reaches ¥98,000, and whether sales keep printing under ¥105,000.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/100567.headline: Slab premium at 1.07x vs a usual 1.76x, ask 8% above sales
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/100567.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask is ¥143,000, about 8% above the ¥132,000 median of recent sales, and 12 of 20 listings sit within 15% of it. Sales are running at about 3.9 a day, with prints between ¥126,800 and ¥142,000 over the past week.

Why: The slab sells at only 1.07x the raw price against a six-month norm of about 1.76x (pokeca-chart, 2026-09-28), so raw is priced high relative to the slab, or the slab is cheap. This is a reading of the data; I found no reprint or supply news for this set.

For you: The ask is just under the Ceiling (¥145,000), well above the Buy line (¥128,000) and your ¥90,000 limit. The correction rule keeps this at Watch.

Watch: Whether sales keep clearing near ¥130,000, and whether the raw price falls toward the slab (which would lift the premium back).
